subject: Observability portal: route-slice visibility + ops handoff
messages:
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: acme-platform-team <platform@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability portal: route-slice visibility + ops handoff

Team — looping you in on a customer request that surfaced in this week's renewal conversation with Acme. They asked for a single console view where their SREs can: 

- Slice traffic by route, model variant, and tenant
- See per-slice token spend, p50/p95 latency, and tail failures in one row
- Attach a replay link or trace to a high-cost row for root-cause investigations

Acme wants this to live in the Console (not a separate internal tool); their lead SRE asked for a demo by 9/28. From a sales perspective we need a clear MVP ask and an ops handoff plan (who owns alerts, runbook links, and escalations) so the renewal team can close.

I've attached a one-pager with suggested fields and a quick UX sketch. High-level asks:

1) Product: confirm which fields are feasible in Q4 and any gating telemetry work (sampling, additional tags).
2) Infra/Runtime (Marcus): estimate data retention/cost impact if we expand route-level retention to 90 days for sampled traces.
3) Soojin/Grace (PM/UX): help craft a prioritized checklist for an SRE-facing MVP and a short demo script.

Please reply with commitments and blockers by EOD today so I can update Acme and the AE.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
Attachments: route_slice_requirements_v1.pdf (pdf), example-ux-sketch.png (image)
From: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability portal: route-slice visibility + ops handoff

Thanks for the ping — quick infra/ops take.

We can expose per-route aggregates (tokens, p50/p95 latency, error rate) into Console with daily rollups without major infra changes; real-time tail tracing will need either:

- Incremental sampling on production pathways + 7-day retention (low cost)
- Full trace capture on-demand via short-lived debug flags (higher cost but bounded)

If Acme wants 90-day sampled traces, estimate: ~+18–22% storage cost in our telemetry tier and we need a small schema bump to include model_variant and tenant_id as indexed tags. That schema change will need a coordinated migration with the ingestion pipeline (2-week slot) and a brief rollout plan.

Blockers:
- Need sign-off from Security for tenant_id indexing (PII concerns) — Irene, can you lead?
- Need product to finalize primary route dimensions (e.g., path + intent vs. full path).

I'll put a rough cost delta in a short doc and link it here by EOD.

— Marcus
Principal Infra Engineer
Attachments: (will add cost sketch)
From: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>, soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 12:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability portal: route-slice visibility + ops handoff

Thanks — I can take the security review. Quick notes:

- tenant_id as an indexed tag is okay if we keep it hashed in raw telemetry and only surface the full id in the customer-owned Console view (i.e., access controls + audit logs required).
- For archived/sampled traces longer than 30 days we should require an explicit customer opt-in and update the data processing agreement; that will need legal review and might delay a universal 90-day policy.

I'll start the security checklist and sync with Legal; aim to have a list of required controls and ACL changes by next Tue (9/18).

Irene
Security & Compliance
From: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability portal: route-slice visibility + ops handoff

Appreciate the quick responses. Summary / next steps from Product/UX: 

MVP scope (what we'll demo to Acme on 9/28):
- Console table with slice rows (route + model_variant + tenant) showing: daily tokens, p50, p95, error-rate, last-high-cost-flag (link to trace)
- Per-row action menu: open trace, create incident, export CSV
- Sampling policy: default 7-day high-fidelity traces; on-demand trace capture for debugging

Deliverables and owners:
- Feature spec + acceptance criteria (Soojin) — draft by 9/18
- UX prototype and demo script (Grace) — prototype by 9/20
- Infra cost delta + migration plan (Marcus) — sketch by 9/14 EOD (Marcus flagged he'll share)
- Security checklist + legal gating items (Irene) — draft by 9/18
- AE-facing demo bullet points and renewal tie-in (Marissa) — Marissa to own demo ask and coordinate with Acme

Risks/Questions:
- We need a clear limit for how many rows/endpoints a customer Console will render before we require aggregation (to avoid client-side JS blowups). Grace, can you propose sensible defaults?
- Will AWS partner need to sign off on any ingestion changes? Marcus, if you need their input I can loop them in.

I'll consolidate the spec + timeline into a short PRD and share the link here (Drive) by Monday. If anyone sees a blocker to the dates above, reply asap.

— Soojin
Senior Product Manager, Console
Soojin@redwood.com
